title: Export with nothing matching shows Empty export and saves no file
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a search text that matches no part at the test location, active or inactive.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the search text that matches no part in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Export.
  4. Wait 5 seconds.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Type the search text that matches no part in the Search box again.
  7. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  8. Click Export.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Active tab lists no parts.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • A message reading "Empty export" appears.

Step 4:

  • No file has downloaded: the browser shows no new download.

Step 5:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 6:

  • The Inactive tab lists no parts.

Step 7:

  • The menu opens.

Step 8:

  • The same message, "Empty export", appears, and no file downloads.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S1-R9b: “The export includes every part on that tab that matches the current search, filters and Supply filter, including parts not yet scrolled into view. With nothing matching, the message "Empty export" shows and no file is made.”
